sites.name: Nguyen Sinh Sac Relic Site
sites.event: The resting place of Junior Doctor Nguyen Sinh Sac (father of President Ho Chi Minh), a key spiritual and cultural architectural complex of the province.

sites.name: Tram Chim National Park
sites.event: The world's 2,000th Ramsar site, conserving red-crowned cranes (a rare bird species listed in the Red Data Book) and a wetland ecosystem.

place.commune: Tram Chim Town (and 5 communes: Phu Duc, Phu Hiep, Phu Thanh B, Phu Tho, Tan Cong Sinh)

sites.name: Xeo Quyt Relic Site
sites.event: The revolutionary base of the Kien Phong Province Party Committee during the anti-American resistance war, famous for its system of secret bunkers and trenches under the canopy of the primary cajuput forest.

place.commune: My Hiep Commune, My Long Commune

sites.name: Sa Dec Flower Village (Tan Quy Dong Flower Village)
sites.event: The ornamental flower capital of the Southwestern region with a history of over 100 years, supplying flowers to the entire country every Tet holiday.

sites.name: Go Thap Special National Relic Site
sites.event: The center of the ancient Oc Eo culture and a revolutionary base during the two resistance wars (home to the Temple of Thien Ho Vo Duy Duong and Doc Binh Nguyen Tan Kieu).

place.commune: Tan Kieu Commune, My Hoa Commune

sites.name: Huynh Thuy Le Ancient House
sites.event: An ancient house with a blend of East-West architecture, associated with the borderless love story between Mr. Huynh Thuy Le and the French writer Marguerite Duras (author of the novel 'The Lover').

sites.name: Gao Giong Eco-tourism Area
sites.event: Known as 'miniature Dong Thap Muoi' with a vast cajuput forest system, bird sanctuary, and unique pioneer cuisine.

sites.name: Phuoc Kien Pagoda (Lotus Leaf Pagoda)
sites.event: Famous for its giant water lily (king lotus) with massive leaves that an adult can stand on without sinking.

sites.name: Thap Muoi Lotus Field
sites.event: A vast lotus-growing region where visitors can experience the atmosphere of 'Thap Muoi is most beautiful with its lotus flowers'.

sites.name: Dinh Yen (Dinh Yen Sedge Mat Village)
sites.event: A famous traditional hand-woven sedge mat craft village, which once featured a unique 'ghost market' (a night market), recognized as a National Intangible Cultural Heritage.

place.hamlet: An Khuong Hamlet, An Loi A Hamlet

sites.name: Kien An Cung (Ong Quach Pagoda)
sites.event: A unique architectural work of the Chinese (Fujian) community built in 1924, recognized as a National Historical and Cultural Relic.
